retrievalProfile.description: A studio portrait of a female vocalist with a 1960s bouffant hairstyle against a solid cyan-blue background, featuring left-aligned stacked typography in contrasting yellow and white.

recipe.visualDefinition: A three-quarter length studio portrait of a woman with voluminous 1960s hair and a white lace dress, positioned on the right side of a flat, saturated blue field. The left side is reserved for clean, blocky typography that uses color to differentiate hierarchy.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject offset to the right to balance left-aligned text
High contrast between white dress and saturated blue background
Yellow accent text providing a warm focal point against cool tones
Soft studio lighting creating gentle shadows on the subject's face
coreInvariants: Left-aligned text block in the upper-left quadrant

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, three-quarter length view.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and hair serve as the primary anchor, balanced by the text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, move left to the title text, then down to the tracklist.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open blue space in the upper left and lower left quadrants.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation background with high-value (bright) subject and text elements.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Condensed slab serif and wide grotesque
letterConstructionRules: Title uses ultra-condensed, heavy slab serifs
Name uses wide, high-contrast slab serifs with bracketed terminals
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between ultra-condensed yellow display type and wide white secondary type.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the wide, bracketed slab serif look of the name text.
Approximates the ultra-condensed weight of the title text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio photograph of a woman with a large 1960s bouffant hairstyle wearing a white sleeveless lace dress, standing against a solid, vibrant cyan-blue background. The woman is positioned on the right side of the frame, looking towards the camera with a smile.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add left-aligned text in the upper-left quadrant. The top line should be in a bold, ultra-condensed yellow slab serif. The second line should be in a wide, white slab serif. A small list of tracks in yellow sans-serif should appear below the main name.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid cyan?
Is the hair styled in a 1960s bouffant?
Is the text left-aligned and color-coded yellow and white?
Is the subject positioned to the right?

mustRedesign: Original artist name and specific track titles
Exact facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Verify text does not overlap the subject's face
Ensure the blue background is uniform and flat
Check that the yellow text is legible against the blue
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Solid Cyan Background + Left-Aligned Slab Serif Typography + 1960s Fashion Styling
